title: Chronos
description: Health of the Chronos testnet as we run it: the consensus bootstrap, the two timekeepers, the RPC node, the Auto EVM bootstrap, RPC and operators, and the two farmers and the archive node on the Auto Drive staging hosts, plus probes of the public RPC names. Chain figures come from the nodes' logs, as their metrics carry no block heights; host figures cover the boxes with a host agent.

list.name: gw
list.description: The files gateway host: the Auto Drive archive node and a farmer

list.name: pub
list.description: The public backend host: a farmer

list.name: tk
list.description: A pattern matching the two timekeepers in Loki, under their hostname now or at their last boot

list.name: agents
list.description: The Chronos hosts that run a host agent, as they appear in metrics

list.name: evm
list.description: A pattern matching the Auto EVM bootstrap, RPC and operator nodes

list.name: ops
list.description: A pattern matching the two Auto EVM operators

list.name: rpcs
list.description: A pattern matching the consensus and Auto EVM RPC nodes, which run Traefik

list.name: chain
list.description: A pattern matching every host running a Chronos node

panels.title: Chain head
panels.description: The highest best block any of our Chronos nodes printed in the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max(max by (host, node) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else if eq .compose_project "subspace-farmer" }}Farmer's node{{ else if hasPrefix "timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-operator" .host }}Auto EVM operator{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-rpc" .host }}Auto EVM RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-bootstrap" .host }}Auto EVM bootstrap{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-rpc" .host }}RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-bootstrap" .host }}Bootstrap{{ else }}{{ .compose_service }}{{ end }}` | unwrap v [5m]))) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Blocks (10 min)
panels.description: Blocks the chain added in the last 10 minutes: how far the highest best block among our nodes rose. Chronos runs at about 45, a block every 13 seconds or so, slower than the 6-second target; below 20 is orange, and 0 means the chain has stalled, or every node has. A farmer must win a slot for a block, and only three farm Chronos: our two and Jim's.

targets.expr: (max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m]))) - max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m] offset 10m)))) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Slot time
panels.description: Seconds per slot over the last 200 blocks, from the monitoring host's reads of the public RPC: about 1.04 while the fastest timekeeper leads, about 2.2 when one is out of step and the network falls back to a slower one. Above 1.3 for 30 minutes raises ChronosSlotsSlow. No data means the chain probe can't read the chain.

targets.expr: max(subspace_chain_slot_seconds{network="chronos"}) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Nodes reporting
panels.description: Of our 11 Chronos consensus nodes (bootstrap, two timekeepers, RPC, the Auto EVM bootstrap, RPC and two operators, the Auto Drive archive node and the two farmers' nodes), how many printed a status line in the last 5 minutes. The Chronos nodes table shows which.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host, compose_project) (count_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" [5m]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Timekeepers
panels.description: Timekeepers whose node imported at least one block in the last 10 minutes. 2 is both. Without a timekeeper no proof of time is produced and the chain stops; this shows each is up and following the chain. Slot time and PoT reorgs show whether they keep it at full speed.

targets.expr: count((max by (host) (max_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else if eq .compose_project "subspace-farmer" }}Farmer's node{{ else if hasPrefix "timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-operator" .host }}Auto EVM operator{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-rpc" .host }}Auto EVM RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-bootstrap" .host }}Auto EVM bootstrap{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-rpc" .host }}RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-bootstrap" .host }}Bootstrap{{ else }}{{ .compose_service }}{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m])) - min by (host) (min_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else if eq .compose_project "subspace-farmer" }}Farmer's node{{ else if hasPrefix "timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-operator" .host }}Auto EVM operator{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-rpc" .host }}Auto EVM RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-bootstrap" .host }}Auto EVM bootstrap{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-rpc" .host }}RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-bootstrap" .host }}Bootstrap{{ else }}{{ .compose_service }}{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m]))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: PoT reorgs (1 h)
panels.description: Proof-of-time reorgs the busier timekeeper logged in the last hour. A couple a week is normal; 5 to 7 an hour means a timekeeper is out of step, and 3 raises ChronosTimekeeperOutOfStep, whose runbook restarts timekeeper 0's node. Every Chronos node logs the same reorgs, so this can't say which timekeeper it is. No data means the timekeepers logged nothing in 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max(sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= `Proof of time chain reorg happened` [1h]))) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Blocks: ours
panels.description: Blocks our two farmers' nodes claimed in the last hour. 0 means neither is winning blocks, and the chain relies on Jim's home farmer alone. A claimed block can still lose a fork, so this can run slightly above what lands on the chain.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} |= `Claimed block at slot` [1h])) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Our share
panels.description: Of the blocks the chain added in the last hour, the share our two farmers' nodes claimed. The rest is Jim's home farmer. Near 100% means the chain depends on our two 1 GiB staging farmers alone. A claimed block can still lose a fork, so this is capped at 100%.

targets.expr: ((100 * sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} |= `Claimed block at slot` [1h])) / (max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m]))) - max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m] offset 1h))))) <= 100) or (vector(100) and on() (100 * sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="node"} |= `Claimed block at slot` [1h])) / (max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m]))) - max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m] offset 1h))))) > 100) or (vector(0) and on() (max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m]))) - max(max by (host) (last_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node"} |= "best: #" != "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | unwrap v [5m] offset 1h))))) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Errors (15 min)
panels.description: Error lines from the Chronos nodes, the farmers, the DSN bootstrap node and the RPC proxies in the last 15 minutes. No data means none of them logged anything in 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node|farmer|dsn-bootstrap-node|traefik"} |~ `"level":\s*"(?i:error|fatal|critical)"|\sERROR\s|^\w*Error:|panicked at` [15m])) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host=~"${chain:raw}"} [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Auto EVM blocks
panels.description: Domain blocks Auto EVM added in the last 10 minutes, from the domain nodes' status lines. Auto EVM only makes a block when an operator has transactions or receipts to bundle, so this stays at 0 for as long as nobody uses the domain. Shown, not judged: the Operators tile says whether the operators are taking part.

targets.expr: max(max by (host, node) (max_over_time({host=~"${evm:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" |= "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else if eq .compose_project "subspace-farmer" }}Farmer's node{{ else if hasPrefix "timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-operator" .host }}Auto EVM operator{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-rpc" .host }}Auto EVM RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-bootstrap" .host }}Auto EVM bootstrap{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-rpc" .host }}RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-bootstrap" .host }}Bootstrap{{ else }}{{ .compose_service }}{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m])) - min by (host, node) (min_over_time({host=~"${evm:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= "best: #" |= "Domain:" | regexp `best: #(?P<v>[0-9]+)` | label_format node=`{{ if eq .compose_project "file-retriever" }}Archive node{{ else if eq .compose_project "subspace-farmer" }}Farmer's node{{ else if hasPrefix "timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-timekeeper" .host }}Timekeeper{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-operator" .host }}Auto EVM operator{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-rpc" .host }}Auto EVM RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-domain-0-bootstrap" .host }}Auto EVM bootstrap{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-rpc" .host }}RPC{{ else if hasPrefix "chronos-bootstrap" .host }}Bootstrap{{ else }}{{ .compose_service }}{{ end }}` | unwrap v [10m]))) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Slots won (10 min)
panels.description: Bundle slots the two Auto EVM operators won in the last 10 minutes. An operator builds a bundle for a won slot only when it has transactions or receipts to include, and skips it otherwise. 0 means neither operator is taking part, so Auto EVM could not make a block. No data means the operators logged nothing in 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"${ops:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= `Claimed slot` [10m])) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host=~"${ops:raw}", compose_service="node"} [5m])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Operators
panels.description: Auto EVM operators that won at least one bundle slot in the last 30 minutes. 2 is both.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"${ops:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= `Claimed slot` [30m])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Public RPC
panels.description: Of the four public RPC names (rpc and rpc-0, auto-evm and auto-evm-0 under chronos.autonomys.xyz), how many passed the monitoring host's last probe: a JSON-RPC system_health call through Cloudflare that must answer 200, not syncing, with peers. 4 is all of them. No data means no probe has reported.

targets.expr: count(probe_success{job="rpc-probe"} == 1) or (vector(0) and on() count(probe_success{job="rpc-probe"})) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Farm warnings
panels.description: Lines from our farmers in the last hour saying a proof was skipped for the farming time limit, a proof failed, a solution could not be sent to the node, or a non-fatal farming error occurred. Each is a block or vote the farmer may have missed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="farmer"} |~ `Proving for solution skipped|Failed to prove|Non-fatal farming error|Failed to send solution` [1h])) or (vector(0) and on() (sum(count_over_time({host=~"$gw|$pub", compose_project="subspace-farmer", compose_service="farmer"} [1h])) > 0)) or (vector(0) - 1)

panels.title: Hosts reporting
panels.description: Chronos hosts whose host agent answered its last scrape: the files gateway, the public backend, the bootstrap and both timekeepers, so 5 is all of them. The AWS nodes have no host agent.

targets.expr: count(count by (host) (up{job="node", host=~"${agents:raw}"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing for the Chronos hosts with a host agent: RAID, SMART, full disks, boot code, a silent server, a scrape target down. No data means the Watchdog alert, which always fires, is absent, so vmalert is not reporting.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname!="Watchdog", host=~"${agents:raw}"}) or (vector(0) and on() (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="Watchdog"}) > 0)) or vector(-1)

options.content: **Chain figures come from the nodes' logs:** most Chronos nodes send no metrics, and those that do report no block heights. **Not covered:** the chain indexer and the chain alerter (no logs reach Loki), which timekeeper is out of step (the reorgs show that one is), the farmers' audits, Jim's home farmer and archive node, the Auto EVM explorer, and host health for the AWS nodes. Green above does not include them.

panels.title: Chronos nodes
panels.description: One row per consensus node we run, from the status line each prints every 5 seconds. Behind head is the gap to the highest best block among them. State is the node's last status line: syncing, synced, or fetching history, synced and downloading older blocks behind it. The archive node on the files gateway serves Auto Drive's DAG indexer. A missing row means the node printed nothing for 5 minutes: compare with the 11 the Nodes reporting tile expects.

panels.title: Auto EVM nodes
panels.description: One row per Auto EVM domain node, from the domain status line each prints beside its consensus one. Their domain status lines read Block history in normal running, so State only flags syncing. Imported stays at 0 while nobody uses the domain, as Auto EVM only makes a block from a bundle. For the two operators: Slots won counts bundle slots each won, Bundles the ones it had transactions or receipts for (it skips empty ones), and Problems the slots it skipped because its domain chain lagged plus errors building or submitting a bundle or receipt.

panels.title: Slot time
panels.description: Seconds per slot over the last 200 blocks, read from the public RPC every minute. The blue line is 1.04, the pace while the fastest timekeeper leads; the red one is 1.3, which held for 30 minutes raises ChronosSlotsSlow. About 2.2 means a timekeeper is out of step.

targets.expr: max(subspace_chain_slot_seconds{network="chronos"})

panels.title: Block time
panels.description: Seconds per block over the same 200 blocks: about 6 in step, about 13 while a timekeeper is out of step.

targets.expr: max(subspace_chain_block_seconds{network="chronos"})

panels.title: PoT reorgs per hour
panels.description: Proof-of-time reorgs each timekeeper logged in the hour before each point. The red line is 3, which raises ChronosTimekeeperOutOfStep. Every Chronos node logs the same reorgs, so the two lines move together whichever timekeeper is out of step.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= `Proof of time chain reorg happened` [1h]))

panels.title: PoT reorg jumps
panels.description: How many slots each proof-of-time reorg went back, from_next_slot minus to_next_slot, as each timekeeper logged it. 270 to 410 is typical while a timekeeper is out of step; the legend's Last is the latest.

targets.expr: max by (host) (max_over_time({host=~"${tk:raw}", compose_service="node"} |= `Proof of time chain reorg happened` | regexp `from_next_slot=(?P<from>[0-9]+) to_next_slot=(?P<to>[0-9]+)` | label_format jump=`{{ sub .from .to }}` | unwrap jump [$__auto]))

panels.description: The last progress each farmer printed while plotting or replotting a sector. Gaps are normal: a 1 GiB farm plots its few sectors quickly, then replots only as sectors expire.

panels.title: Public RPC endpoints
panels.description: The monitoring host's last probe of each public RPC name: a JSON-RPC system_health call through Cloudflare, every minute. Healthy needs a 200 answer, not syncing, with peers. The certificate is the one Cloudflare presents, not the node's own.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (instance) (probe_success{job="rpc-probe"}), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")
label_replace(max by (instance) (probe_http_status_code{job="rpc-probe"}), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")
label_replace(max by (instance) (probe_duration_seconds{job="rpc-probe"}), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")
label_replace(min by (instance) (probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="rpc-probe"} - time()), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")

panels.title: Public RPC probes passing
panels.description: Whether each public RPC name passed its probe, 1 or 0, minute by minute.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (instance) (probe_success{job="rpc-probe"}), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")

panels.title: Public RPC response time
panels.description: How long each probe took, through Cloudflare, from the monitoring host.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (instance) (probe_duration_seconds{job="rpc-probe"}), "instance", "$1", "instance", "https://([^/]+)/.*")

panels.title: RPC proxy responses by status
panels.description: Responses the Traefik proxies in front of the consensus and Auto EVM RPC nodes logged, by status class. WebSocket upgrades are 1xx. This shows the nodes answering what reaches them, not whether the public names reach them.

targets.expr: sum by (host, status) (count_over_time({host=~"${rpcs:raw}", compose_service="traefik"} |= "HTTP/" | regexp `" (?P<status>[1-5])[0-9][0-9] ` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Free space on /
panels.description: Free space on / of the Chronos hosts with a host agent. Their nodes keep their chain data in Docker volumes on /, so this falls as the chain grows, fastest where a node keeps every block.

targets.expr: max by (host) (deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{host=~"${agents:raw}", mountpoint="/"}[6h])) * -86400

panels.title: Error lines
panels.description: Error lines from the Chronos nodes, farmers, DSN bootstrap node and RPC proxies.

targets.expr: {host=~"${chain:raw}", compose_service=~"node|subspace-node|farmer|dsn-bootstrap-node|traefik"} |~ `"level":\s*"(?i:error|fatal|critical)"|\sERROR\s|^\w*Error:|panicked at` | line_format "[{{.host}} {{.compose_service}}] {{__line__}}"
